title: Flex
oneLiner: flex 컨테이너 — direction·align·justify·gap 프롭, inline 전환. Box 파생.

web.code:
<jd-flex direction="{direction}" align="{align}" justify="{justify}" gap="{gap}">
  <jd-box p="2" bg="card" radius="md" border>A</jd-box>
  <jd-box p="2" bg="card" radius="md" border>B</jd-box>
  <jd-box p="2" bg="card" radius="md" border>C</jd-box>
</jd-flex>
